Alma Healthcare Partners ("Alma") is a private investment firm targeting investments in skilled nursing facilities across the United States, with a primary focus in California. Alma provides liquidity solutions and operational support to both real property holders and facility operators — through direct acquisitions, joint ventures, and lease structures.

Alma's principals bring decades of combined experience in healthcare real estate, private capital, and skilled nursing operations. The firm has the capital and operational infrastructure to transact across market cycles, at any scale, with speed and certainty.

For inquiries, please contact investments@almahp.com.

Investment Type

  • Direct acquisition of real property (PropCo)
  • Direct acquisition of operating entities (OpCo)
  • Joint venture partnerships
  • Sale-leaseback and long-term lease structures
  • Operational partnerships for scaling operators
  • Rescue capital and structured recapitalizations with equity participation

Transaction Size

  • Portfolio acquisitions in excess of $500 million
  • Single-facility transactions considered
  • All-cash, no financing contingencies

Asset Class

  • Licensed skilled nursing facilities
  • Post-acute and long-term care facilities
  • SNF-anchored real estate portfolios
  • Primary focus in California, active across all major U.S. markets

Opportunity Profile

  • Transitional capital events and other special situations, including but not limited to:
    • Acquisition, development, and repositioning opportunities
    • Bankruptcies and restructurings, including DIP financings with equity participation
    • Rescue capital and structured recapitalizations with equity participation
    • Non-performing loans where equity conversion or co-investment is available

Who We Work With

  • PropCo owners seeking liquidity or a full exit
  • Operators seeking a capital partner, acquirer, or operational support
  • Owners and operators open to JV or lease structures in lieu of an outright sale
  • Multi-facility portfolios seeking a single, well-capitalized buyer

Intermediaries & Advisors

  • Alma welcomes introductions from advisors and intermediaries who work with SNF owners and operators. The firm provides fee protection on all transactions introduced on an off-market basis and emphasizes confidentiality and rapid decision-making. These groups have included:
    • Healthcare real estate brokers and investment sales advisors
    • Debt and equity placement advisors
    • M&A and restructuring advisors
    • Healthcare operators and management companies
    • Receivers, trustees, and bankruptcy counsel

Alma does not engage in consumer telemarketing. Its communications relate solely to potential commercial real estate acquisitions, joint ventures, lease arrangements, and investment transactions involving skilled nursing facilities and related healthcare real estate.
  • Recipients of Alma's communications are sophisticated business principals who own, operate, or control commercial real estate or licensed healthcare facilities. Alma's outreach constitutes commercial speech directed to commercial actors and is not subject to the consumer-protection provisions of the TCPA to the same extent as consumer telemarketing.
